name: Work Fleet
subtitle: One note. One thing.
shortDescription: Capture ideas and tasks, organize notes in groups, and sync with Google Drive.
fullDescription:
Keep the thought. Start the next step.

Work Fleet collects ideas, tasks, and work notes with one thing per card.

• Capture a note quickly and keep local drafts as you type.
• Write with Markdown, checklists, and attachments.
• Organize notes in up to nine groups, search them, and mark them complete or archive them.
• Keep encrypted local data and continue writing offline.
• Optionally sync through your Google account using Drive's app data space.
• Preserve conflicting versions so you can choose how to resolve changes.
• Export complete backups of notes, groups, drafts, and attachments, with optional password encryption. Import, merge, or restore a backup.

Google sync is optional. Existing local notes remain in a separate workspace when you sign in. Keep your backup password in a safe place.
